entries.prompt:
and call it a day

so i ran the same 142-word prompt with some tricky art direction across 7 different models at 2k resolution in a cinematic 21:9 aspect ratio.

the models for each image are in the same order as the list below. i also wrote them inside the alt descriptions of each image.

turns out 0/7 followed every physical instruction in the prompt. literally 0% 🤣 nice job guys.

and here's how the geometry within each output split across the 7 results:
- camera framing ("medium close-up at seated shoulder height"): 4/7 so over half listened. mango, nano banana, and seedream pulled the shot back into full body or wide shots.
- piano lid (unspecified in prompt): 3 popped the top (mango, z-image, and gpt image 2.6 sunburst). the other 4 kept it closed, very traditional of them,
- orientation and rules: every model besides seedream 5.5 faced the camera right, while seedream faced it left.

and it's interesting to look at all of them side by side, because every image model prioritized a different part of the prompt (in no particular order):

- gpt image 2.6 sunburst: best emotional post for sure. it's the only model that arched the spine and neck way back like the real "final note: of a performance. plus the sharp shadows on the ribs.
- nano banana 2.1 pro: cleanest sky model adherence. the only model that rendered "exactly one immense sunlit cloud"
- z-image + z-image turbo: they locked the shoulder-height tigher crop,but turbo snuck some extra clouds onto the horizon to the left of the skeletons head. this didn't take a ton away from the image but matters while we analyze prompt adherence. |
- mango 4 by @magespace_: definitely the best cinematic image with the framing and golden-hour depth. it opened the piano lid which looks better than closed, and nailed the full-scene lighting. minus a few points for zooming out a bit far.
- seedream 5.5: worst of the bunch in terms of quality and vibe. the ultra-wide landscape isn't what we were going for, though this could improve with a few more gens so we'll give seedream a pass on this one
- minimax h3: nailed the tight shoulder height crop and the contrast between the sky and rich wheat field is what i had in mind when creating the prompt. solid result.

every ai image model is going to have its strengths and weaknesses, so it's best to run multiple gens and compare across different image models if the output is important.

and even though none of the models leaned the skeleton's ribs against the piano or gave it limp wrists like was requested, there are some solid results here. imo, H3, GPT-Image, and MANGO are the clear winners and which one is best depends on the vibe you're going for.

here's the exact 142 word prompt:

"Intimate three-quarter profile, medium close-up at seated shoulder height. A pristine white grand piano and matching bench stand alone amid endless rolling amber-orange wheat. The foreground is dominated by a white skeleton seated at the keyboard, its ribs leaning against the piano’s side, its long neck arched backward and its open jaw aimed toward the sky. The pose carries the extravagant emotion of a singer giving everything to one final note, but the limp wrists, settled spine and unmoving bones make it clear the performance ended long ago. Its skeleton is the exact porcelain white of the piano, almost a sculptural extension of the instrument. Keep the skull sharply resolved against open blue sky while the white piano curves away into the field. Exactly one immense sunlit cloud rises above the distant wheat-covered hills. Golden-hour sidelight, long shadows, luminous wheat heads and soft reflections on immaculate lacquer. Peaceful surrealism, lonely dreamcore Americana, faded pastoral grandeur without horror. Delicate grain, natural tonal separation, no buildings, no other figures, no text."

if you test it yourself with any tweaks, i'd love to see the results!

and now that X allows for more than 4 images, i'll do more of these comparisons.

头顶发根蓬松，采用松散的古典高盘发造型，部分长发盘成不规则蓬松发髻，具有自然的发束层次。

额前几缕轻薄凌乱的八字碎刘海自然垂落，修饰额头与脸颊。

耳侧和后颈保留大量细长碎发，部分发丝在微风中向外飘散。

画面右侧发髻佩戴精致的白色珍珠花卉发簪，点缀数颗大小不同的珍珠与金属枝叶。

强烈暖金色逆光照亮头顶、发髻和飞散碎发，形成明亮清晰的金白色发丝轮廓光。

【服装与首饰】

身穿浅樱花粉色、珍珠粉色的现代改良真丝旗袍。

柔软细腻的丝绸缎面，具有自然珍珠光泽，修身剪裁，贴合真实身体轮廓。

领口采用精致的小立领设计，领部浅粉色丝绸自然包裹颈部。

肩部采用极细浅粉色肩带设计，露出自然肩颈与背部部分轮廓。

旗袍表面装饰精致的浅粉色花卉刺绣、细小立体花瓣与少量银白色丝线。

面料具有真实丝绸光泽、自然柔软褶皱与细腻刺绣纹理。

整体服装优雅、轻盈、精致，融合东方传统元素与现代时尚剪裁。

【人物姿势——核心】

人物站立在深色摄影棚内，身体侧向镜头约70度。

肩膀自然放松，上半身保持柔和侧身姿态，背部部分朝向镜头。

头部自然向后回转，形成优雅的三分之四侧脸回眸。

下巴微微收起，双眼平静地直视镜头，嘴唇自然微张。

靠近镜头的一只手抬至胸前，手指轻轻握住旗袍领口附近的柔软面料。

另一只手臂自然放松，部分隐藏在身体另一侧。

肩颈线条自然舒展，整体姿势优雅、安静、略带清冷感。

【背景与光影——最重要】

深黑色极简摄影棚背景，黑色与深暖棕色自然渐变，没有任何家具或复杂装饰。

人物身后偏右上方设置一盏强烈的暖金色逆光灯，光线从头顶后方斜向照射。

头顶、盘发外缘、耳侧碎发、后颈与肩膀边缘形成非常明亮的金白色轮廓光。

大量独立飞散发丝在逆光照射下清晰可见，形成细腻的金色发丝光晕。

人物面部由柔和中性偏冷的正面补光照亮，使脸部保持清透冷白色。

面部具有柔和自然阴影，鼻梁、脸颊和嘴唇具有真实高光。

浅粉色真丝旗袍受到暖金色光线照射，呈现柔和的珍珠粉色与香槟金色反光。

背景保持深黑色，人物轮廓明亮，形成鲜明的电影级明暗对比。

【镜头与构图】

9:16竖版，等效85mm人像镜头，眼睛高度平视拍摄。

人物位于画面中央，头顶保留适量黑色负空间。

采用侧身回眸中景构图，呈现头部、肩膀、胸前手部与旗袍至腰臀附近。

面部清晰，眼睛为视觉焦点，发髻与飞散碎发边缘清晰。

真实摄影景深，细腻皮肤纹理、独立发丝、真实丝绸材质，轻微光学柔焦与自然颗粒。

单幅独立画面，无文字，无水印，无LOGO，无拼图。

【负面提示词】

entries.prompt:
OF THE DAY!
DAY 04 of my challenge and today we have Dungeonpunk + Redcarpet. so, what if you where a movie star in a Fantasy World?
Special Thanks To: @3p0n4r0xx0rs , @vovilliacorp , @CountessLilithB , @NovaNekura , @Synnerette and @WhompWave

Dungeonpunk Legends of the Silver Screen By Jolly Joebean

Prompt Start
---

**THEME:** Dungeonpunk × Heroic Fantasy × Magitek × Armored Haute Couture × Celebrity Glamour × Fantasy Cinema

**OUTPUT:** Exactly ONE breathtaking, highly detailed, PHOTOREALISTIC cinematic image.

**FORMAT:** One OC = vertical 2:3. Two OCs = landscape 3:2.

**REFERENCES:** @Image1 = required first OC. @Image2 = optional second OC.

## 1. THE CHALLENGE
**WHAT WOULD YOUR OC WEAR TO A RED-CARPET PREMIERE IN A DUNGEONPUNK WORLD?**

Portray the referenced OC or pair as glamorous movie stars deliberately posing for photographers outside an elite fantasy movie theater. Their sensational formalwear combines luxurious celebrity fashion with ceremonial armor and magically powered technology. Dungeonpunk is a fully developed civilization of heroic fantasy and industrialized magic: enchanted crystals, alchemy, rune-engineering, mechanical armor and functional magitek infrastructure.

**It must look like an actual celebrity photograph in a real Dungeonpunk world.** No anime, cartoon, painting, CGI or video-game screenshots; no collage or character sheet.

## 2. INPUTS, CHARACTER IDENTITY & AUTOMATIC CHOICES
**Multimodal LLM:** Examine each supplied character sheet independently before constructing the scene or directing an image generator. Extract only visible/established facts: face and facial proportions, eyes and their color, hair color/length/texture/style, skin tone and markings, apparent age, build, species, anatomy, ears, tails, horns, wings and other distinguishing features. Do not invent missing character facts. If you can generate the image directly, do so; otherwise provide a complete image-generation prompt applying every instruction here, not an explanatory essay.

**Image generator:** Treat each attached image as the absolute authority on that character's appearance. Translate illustrated or stylized OCs into physically plausible, recognizable photorealistic living beings, retaining their identity, age, body proportions, facial features, markings and species-specific structures. Do not humanize nonhuman characters, merge identities or substitute generic faces.

**Reference count:** With @Image1 alone, feature exactly one OC, alone. With @Image1 and @Image2, feature exactly those two OCs together as a glamorous celebrity couple. Never invent an extra date, partner or featured OC, duplicate a character or exchange their features.

**Outfit selection:** Female OCs wear the women's fixed gown; male OCs wear the men's fixed suit. Determine the category separately for each. Use established character gender, or clear gender presentation if no gender is documented. Only if genuinely unclear, ask which of the two outfit categories is preferred. Two women may wear two gowns; two men may wear two suits. Adapt garment fit to nonhuman anatomy, never alter the specified designs.

**Authority rule:** The reference determines WHO the OC is. This prompt determines WHAT the OC wears. Do not recolor, redesign or personalize the fixed clothes based on the OC's original outfit, palette, personality, backstory, powers or accessories. Do not ask for a name, description, palette or other information already present on the reference sheet.

## 3. WOMEN'S LOCKED DESIGN: SILVER ARMORED EVENING GOWN
Create elegant red-carpet COUTURE, not battlefield gear:

**Gown:** Luminous, metallic-SILVER satin with genuine soft textile sheen, folds and drape. Sleek fitted silhouette, beautifully sculpted waist and hips, floor-length flowing skirt and dramatic sweeping train. Fabric must remain fabric, not solid metallic body armor.

**Armored bodice:** A fitted breastplate-inspired corset integrated into the gown, primarily polished SILVER with BRONZE accents. Gracefully layered anatomical plates, sophisticated filigree, delicate bronze engraving/ornament and refined ceremonial metalwork. Elegant full coverage without an oversized combat breastplate; maintain the gown's silhouette.

**Arms:** Proportional silver-and-bronze articulated bracers, overlapping forearm plates and delicate decorative armor, allowing realistic movement. No giant pauldrons or bulky gauntlets.

**Pink stole:** A HUGE, sumptuous, voluminous plush FUR STOLE in rose-pink/dusty-pink, wrapped across shoulders and upper arms like an extravagant celebrity accessory. Show realistic individual fur fibers and enough of the armored corset to display its craftsmanship. The stole is mandatory.

**Slit and footwear:** Precisely tailored dramatic skirt slit rising from the hem to MID-THIGH, with the train still flowing behind. Through the slit, clearly expose at least one elegant, sleek SILVER armored boot with BRONZE trim, sculpted metal plates, refined fantasy ornament and believable articulation. Boots are ceremonial fashion, not heavy combat footwear. The boot must correctly connect to the visible leg.

**Headpiece:** Regal POLISHED BRONZE headband/circlet decorated with sculpted wing-like metal ornaments, intricate detailing, PINK accents and a sophisticated central forehead ornament. Fit it around the OC's actual hair, ears, horns and other features without hiding the recognizable face or replacing the natural hairstyle.

**Women's exact signature:** Silver satin gown and long train; silver-and-bronze armored corset and arms; huge pink fur stole; mid-thigh slit; visible silver-and-bronze armored boots; bronze winged headband with pink accents. Every feature matters.

## 4. MEN'S LOCKED DESIGN: SILVER ARMORED THREE-PIECE SUIT
Create aristocratic black-tie COUTURE, still a tailored three-piece suit, not medieval armor.

**Tailoring:** A sharply fitted, SINGLE-BREASTED SILVER jacket with elegant lapels and polished BRONZE buttons; a distinct matching SILVER DOUBLE-BREASTED waistcoat; and traditional tailored SILVER CLOTH trousers with clean creases and natural textile folds. Underneath: a crisp WHITE formal shirt. Real fabric, not metal leg armor.

**Waistcoat:** Traditional V-shaped neckline, fitted construction, TWO VERTICAL ROWS of bronze buttons; remain visible beneath jacket and harness.

**Armor and chainmail:** Elegantly scaled SILVER-and-BRONZE shoulder pauldrons and upper-jacket plating, with engraved fantasy metalwork, ornate bronze details, buckles and integrated fasteners. Visible BRONZE CHAINMAIL, made of discernible interlocking rings, appears on shoulders/upper torso beneath/between armor, preserving the jacket silhouette.

**Alchemical harness:** A clearly visible DIAGONAL CROSS-BODY leather-like harness crossing the upper torso, fitted with refined straps, polished bronze buckles, metallic attachments and MULTIPLE small glass alchemical vials containing faintly glowing magical reagents. Keep it secure and functional without hiding tie, waistcoat or boutonniere.

**Accessories:** Luxurious BRONZE-and-PINK silk necktie, with woven/striped/ornamental pattern; matching bronze-and-pink POCKET SQUARE clearly visible in the breast pocket; and a distinctive REAL TEAL FLOWER boutonniere pinned to the lapel. The teal accent MUST be floral, not a jewel or metal insignia. Polished BLACK formal dress shoes.

**Legs:** Entirely conventional tailored SILVER FABRIC trousers, never armored thighs, metallic pants, chainmail leggings or mechanical leg coverings.

**Crown:** Tall, dramatic aristocratic fantasy CROWN, primarily POLISHED BRONZE with SILVER decorative accents and embedded GRAY GEMSTONES. Include tall angular spires, sophisticated layered metalwork and regal detail. Fit without hiding face, hair, ears or horns.

**Men's exact signature:** Silver three-piece suit with double-breasted waistcoat and bronze buttons; elegant silver/bronze shoulder armor; bronze chainmail; diagonal vial-bearing alchemical harness; bronze-and-pink tie and pocket square; teal floral boutonniere; plain silver cloth trousers; black shoes; tall bronze/silver crown with gray gemstones. Every feature matters.

## 5. THE DUNGEONPUNK MOVIE PREMIERE
Stage everything outside an ELITE MOVIE THEATER, not an ordinary castle, dungeon or royal palace. The architecture must communicate cinema and celebrity spectacle within a developed industrial-magical fantasy civilization.

**Theater façade:** Monumental GOTHIC STONE construction, enormous carved ceremonial entrance doors and arches, ornate columns, friezes, exquisite fantasy masonry and visible architectural depth. Integrate intricately engineered bronze/brass/steel machinery, glowing enchanted crystals, engraved runic energy conduits, advanced alchemical engines and elegant magitek lighting. The magical engineering should appear functional and constructed, as natural to its society as electricity is to ours.

**Red carpet:** Rich CRIMSON-RED carpet leading to the theater doors, with GOLD/BRONZE trim, velvet crowd-control ropes and ornate metal-and-stone stanchions. The referenced OC(s) pose prominently on it.

**Statues:** Impressive GRAY STONE or BLACK MARBLE fantasy statues of legendary champions, warriors, monarchs or mythical guardians flank/decorate the entrance. Some may have softly glowing runes or embedded crystals. They are architectural background elements, not additional living characters.

**Magitek atmosphere:** Translucent mineral crystals with plausible internal glow; arcane power conduits, alchemical machinery and mechanical devices with physically convincing parts and construction. Heroic fantasy and industrial magic coexist seamlessly.

## 6. MULTIRACIAL FANTASY PRESS CORPS
Populate the sides/background of the carpet with an excited, professional press contingent: a credible mix of ELVES, DWARVES, ORCS, GOBLINS, HALFLINGS, HUMANS and possibly other appropriate fantasy peoples. They look like physically real individuals in sophisticated Dungeonpunk professional/event clothing.

Their equipment consists of CRYSTAL-POWERED CAMERAS, enchanted lenses, magical flashes, mechanical recorders and alchemical communications instruments. Some journalists photograph the featured arrivals as camera flashes flare; others watch or report. Keep the press secondary to the featured OCs.

## 7. EXACTLY FOUR FANTASY MOVIE POSTERS
On the theater's BACK WALL, include EXACTLY FOUR DISTINCT, elegantly illuminated movie-poster displays. Each must depict original fantasy reinterpretation artwork, evocative of its film premise, rather than reproducing existing poster compositions, actors or likenesses. Use recognizable film titles OR the listed fantasy titles, with legible short text where practical:

1. **ROBOCOP / THE ENCHANTED LAWKEEPER:** A formidable reconstructed fantasy-city law-enforcement guardian, armored through runic machinery, enchanted metal and alchemy, protecting a dangerous fantasy metropolis.
2. **THE TERMINATOR / THE RUNEBOUND HUNTER:** A terrifying, unstoppable humanoid construct animated by forbidden magical engineering, advancing from a ruined industrial-fantasy city.
3. **ROCKY / THE UNDERDOG GLADIATOR:** A determined, unlikely fantasy prizefighter training or preparing for a great championship with enchanted athletic equipment and an impressive magical arena; communicate courage and perseverance.
4. **YOU'VE GOT MAIL / YOU'VE GOT SPELLMAIL:** A charming fantasy romantic comedy about two people exchanging messages through enchanted correspondence crystals in a magical city; warm, playful contrast to the action posters.

Each poster occupies a separate illuminated background frame. Do not add a fifth poster or invent extra film advertisements. If lengthy lettering is unreliable, emphasize original illustrative storytelling and concise legible titles, NOT nonsense typography. Posters stay secondary to the fashions.

## 8. MANDATORY PHOTOREALISM & LIGHTING
Depict a physically real, inhabited fantasy world as captured by a high-end LIVE-ACTION celebrity/fashion photographer. Character anatomy, faces and identities remain recognizable but exhibit believable skin, hair, eyes, fur, feathers, scales and other species-appropriate surface detail. No plastic CGI skin or generic humanization.

Render physically credible lustrous satin, fine silver suit fabric, individual pink fur fibers, polished silver/bronze metal, individually linked chainmail, leather harness straps, translucent glass vials, reflective gray gemstones and sculpted crowns/headbands. Clothing and armor have proper weight, natural wrinkles, accurate contact points, reflections and functioning fasteners. The theater has realistic stone grain, weathering, scale, structure, atmosphere and depth. Crystal light refracts through plausible translucent minerals; machines have comprehensible physical mechanisms.

**Lighting:** Warm golden theater illumination + colorful enchanted-crystal glows + brilliant magical camera flashes + dramatic nighttime shadows + convincing metal reflections + premium event-photography lighting + cinematic depth of field. Keep OC(s) sharp and prominent, with readable but secondary architecture, people and film posters. Avoid anime, cel shading, painting, flat illustration, plastic CGI and videogame-render aesthetics.

## 9. POSE: FAMOUS MOVIE STARS, NOT CANDID SUBJECTS
The featured OC(s) knowingly display their outfits for photographers with confident, glamorous, natural red-carpet composure. Expressions may be distinguished, warmly smiling, playfully amused or affectionate.

**Solo woman:** A graceful full-body fashion pose: one hand on hip, a slight turn to display the armored corset, one foot forward to reveal the boot through the slit, or a hand displaying/adjusting the stole. The silver skirt train flows behind. Keep stole, circlet, armor and boot readable.

**Solo man:** Distinguished full-body pose: relaxed upright posture, hand in pocket, adjusting lapel, or slight turn displaying shoulder armor. Face photographers and visibly showcase crown, armor, harness/vials, tie, waistcoat and teal boutonniere.

**Two OCs:** Coordinated celebrity-couple pose, e.g. side by side, arm in arm, holding hands, gentle waist embrace, proud presentation or shared affectionate glance. Either partner may lead; do not impose traditional gender roles. Preserve visibility of BOTH faces, silhouettes, outfits and accessories. Maintain physically plausible relative height and interpersonal contact.

**This is an intentionally posed CELEBRITY MOVIE-PREMIERE PHOTOGRAPH, not a candid dance, wedding portrait or action scene.**

## 10. CAMERA & FRAMING
**One OC:** VERTICAL 2:3, full-length head-to-toe; show headwear, entire dress/train or jacket/trousers, and shoes/armored boots. Do not crop the outfit.

**Two OCs:** LANDSCAPE 3:2, both full length, correctly proportioned and comfortably framed with room for both crowns/headpieces, dramatic skirts, flowing trains and all accessories. Neither OC may cover the other's important details.

**Visual hierarchy:** First, recognizable main OC(s) and the complete fixed haute couture. Second, crimson carpet and fantasy photographers along its sides. Third, a clear grand magitek movie-theater façade, statues, glowing crystals and exactly four illuminated posters. Use coherent perspective, realistic scale and atmospheric depth.

## 11. ANATOMY & FINAL QUALITY CONTROL
Respect the established anatomy of each species. Ordinary humanlike hands have exactly FOUR FINGERS AND ONE THUMB, five digits per hand, with natural thumb placement, joints and finger lengths. Fingers may be naturally hidden by perspective, but never missing, fused, duplicated or malformed. Humanlike bodies normally have one head/torso, two arms and two legs, unless the reference establishes otherwise; no impossible joints, disconnected limbs, duplicated body parts or distorted posture.

Preserve nonhuman ears, horns, wings, tails, unusual hands/feet, body shapes, markings and other structures. Fit the crown, headband, armor and clothes around these; do not erase them. Couple embraces/handholding must not create merged hands, impossible overlaps or strange limb connections. Ensure visible boots join the correct legs, crowns sit securely, harnesses attach logically, trousers remain CLOTH, and armor does not float.

**Do not add:** extra OCs, invented romantic partners, split screens, comparison sheets, inaccurate faces, mismatched outfits, swapped character traits, combat armor replacing couture, armored trousers, missing signature accessories, cropped shoes/headpieces, generic castles, absent press or statues, extra/missing/unrelated movie posters, copied existing film-poster art, unnecessary captions, floating labels, signatures or watermarks.

## 12. FINAL IMAGE DIRECTIVE
Generate **ONE PHOTOREALISTIC, full-body celebrity red-carpet image** of the referenced OC or pair at an elite Dungeonpunk movie premiere. Apply the exact gender-appropriate silver/bronze couture, including every pink, teal, alchemical and crown/headband detail specified. Place them amid the crimson carpet, fantasy journalists with magitek cameras, Gothic theater, luminous crystal technology, carved guardian statues and four original fantasy reinterpretation posters inspired by RoboCop, The Terminator, Rocky and You've Got Mail.

Preserve identities, anatomy, couture silhouettes, real materials and premium nighttime fashion photography.

**ONE SCENE. ONE OR TWO OCs. SPECTACULAR ARMORED COUTURE. FANTASY MOVIE PREMIERE. PHOTOREALISTIC DUNGEONPUNK.**

--
Prompt End

25岁成年东亚女性。自然椭圆脸，鼻梁和脸颊有少量细小雀斑；浅棕色眼睛，眼神灵动，眉毛自然，鼻尖微翘，唇形柔软。深棕色长发，海风吹乱的蓬松纹理，发尾微卷。身材健康丰盈，D罩杯视觉效果，胸部自然饱满，腰部纤细，臀部圆润挺翘。气质自由、清新、略带野性，像海边度假的真实抓拍。

【身材特征】
成年女性拥有柔和圆润的女性身体曲线，胸部与臀部自然丰盈，腰线柔和，整体不刻意纤瘦，真实自然。

成年女性穿着黑白撞色三角比基尼，简洁利落的色块拼接与不透明弹力泳装面料，合身剪裁自然贴合身形并保持适度遮盖，外搭宽松白色衬衫，呈现简约时髦的夏日海滨风格。

【动作姿势】
成年女性坐在沙发或躺椅边缘，双腿自然交叠，身体微微侧转并回眸看向镜头，姿态优雅、从容，突出服装轮廓。

相机位于人物身体一侧，以接近九十度的侧面方向取景，突出鼻梁、下颌、肩部和身体侧面轮廓，人物与背景之间保持适当距离，使轮廓清晰。

entries.prompt: 构建、初稿生成、方案评估四个可操作环节，形成“人工守核、AI 拓维、双轨共创”的IP 打造流程，并以赫哲族少女 IP 从提示词到三视图、再到三维模型的全过程实践加以检验。结果表明，该机制能在保障非遗文化真实性的同时显著拓展视觉创意维度与产出效率；同时揭示生成式人工智能在文化语境理解、风格同质化与署名伦理方面的固有风险，提出以人工复核与文化阐释作为制度化约束。研究可为少数民族地域文旅 IP 的人机协同设计与文化赋能提供实践参考。 关键词：文旅 IP；生成式人工智能；赫哲族；非物质文化遗产；人机协同设计；黑龙江 Co-creation of Heilongjiang Cultural Tourism IP: Generative AI EmpowermentIntegrated with Traditional Humanistic Design LU Yi (School of History, Culture and Tourism, Heilongjiang University, Harbin 150080, China) Abstract: The iterative upgrading of digital intelligent technologies has pushed the construction of cultural tourismIPintoanew stage of human-machine collaborative co-creation, in which the traditional single-track creative model can no longer meet the demand for differentiated and high-quality regional brands. Taking the intangible cultural heritage (ICH) tourismIPof the Hezhe people in northern Heilongjiang as its case, this paper builds a dual-track collaborative creation systemthat combines generative artificial intelligence (AI) empowerment with in-depth humanistic design. On one track, fieldinvestigation, archival collation, cultural symbol extraction and refined manual polishing are used to mine the fishing-and- hunting heritage and border folk customs of the Hezhe people and to safeguard cultural authenticity. On the other track, themultimodal visual generation, iterative styling and scheme deduction capacities of generative AI are introduced to overcomethe long cycles, limited perspectives and monotonous forms of manual creation. The collaborative mechanismis decomposedinto four operational steps—symbol extraction, prompt construction, draft generation and scheme evaluation—forming anIPdevelopment flow of human stewardship of the cultural core, AI-driven dimensional expansion and dual-track co-creation, which is then tested through the complete practice of a Hezhe girl IP from prompt to three-view drawing and to a 3Dmodel. The results show that the mechanism expands visual creativity and output efficiency while safeguarding the authenticityof ICH, and that generative AI carries inherent risks in cultural context comprehension, stylistic homogenisation and authorshipethics, for which manual review and cultural interpretation are proposed as institutional constraints. The study offers practical reference for human-machine collaborative design and cultural empowerment of tourism IP in ethnic minority regions. Keywords: cultural tourism IP; generative artificial intelligence; Hezhe ethnic group; intangible cultural heritage; human- machine collaborative design; Heilongjiang ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 2 1 引言 文旅 IP 是区域文化资源向品牌资产转化的关键中介。它把一个地方的自然景观、历史记忆与生活方式压缩为可识别、可延展、可传播的符号系统，从而在同质化的目的地竞争中形成辨识度。近年来黑龙江依托冰雪资源获得空前流量，冰雪旅游的产品设计与品牌表达随之成为研究热点[1]；但流量并未自动转化为品牌资产，省内文旅 IP 仍呈零散状态，标签单一、季节性明显，尚未形成具有省域专属辨识度的核心形象。 与此同时，生成式人工智能正在改写视觉设计的生产方式。吴余青等指出，AIGC已重构包装图形设计的作业流程，形成“人机协同”的设计模式，设计师的职能由执行转向判断与整合[2]；王瑶从应用策略角度讨论了 AIGC 介入设计各环节的适配条件[3]；徐卖秋则关注生成式工具驱动的视觉风格迭代，认为其价值在于以低成本试错换取风格收敛[4]；慎哲楷、刘洁进一步从传播机制出发，归纳出叙事型、氛围型与资产型三类生成式视觉范式[5]。在文化遗产领域，张茹、王丹提出赫哲族非遗技艺的“智慧活化”及其文旅 IP 转化路径[6]；杨眉对赫哲族鱼皮纹饰的审美意蕴作了系统梳理[7]，张敏杰的《渔家天锦》则为鱼皮文化的整体研究奠定了基础[8]。 两条研究脉络各有侧重：技术一侧关注流程与效率，文化一侧关注意义与真实性，但少有研究把二者放进同一条设计流程中检验——AI 究竟在哪个环节可以放手，哪个环节必须由人守住，仍缺少可操作的答案。本文以一次完整的赫哲族文旅 IP 设计实践为个案，记录从问题识别、符号萃取、提示词构建、初稿生成到三维成型的全过程，据此提出并检验“人工守核、AI 拓维”的双轨协同机制。研究属案例研究性质，材料来自设计过程记录、工具输出与文献比对，尚未开展面向受众的认知度与传播效果量化测评，相关结论的适用范围以本个案为限。 2 问题识别：流量结构失衡与 IP 空位 2.1 冰雪依赖下的品牌短板 黑龙江文旅的现有优势高度集中于冬季：冰雪景观、雪场体验与节庆活动构成了传播主线，夏季则缺乏同等量级的记忆点。这种“单季驱动”的结构带来两个后果。其一，品牌叙事被季节绑定，全年传播难以持续；其二，视觉表达趋于同构，雪、冰、雾凇、俄式建筑反复出现，形成可被快速复制的地域模板。要打破这一循环，需要引入不依赖季节的文化载体，把“冷资源”转化为可全年讲述的“热文化”。 2.2 借助 AI 工具完成的 IP 现状扫描 确定载体之前，先要摸清既有 IP 的分布与缺口。人工搜集本地文旅IP 耗时且易漏，本研究改用“AI 检索＋人工复核”的两段式方法：先以豆包、DeepSeek 等工具就省域内已公开的文旅IP、吉祥物、品牌口号作主题检索与归类，再由研究者逐条回溯官方发布与新闻报道加以核验，剔除无来源或重复项。结果显示，现有 IP 多围绕冰雪景观、边境风情、东北民俗、林海雪原四类主题展ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 3 开，与东北其他省份的 IP 存在明显同质，缺少以族群文化为内核的形象。梳理结果与问题对照见图 1。 图 1 黑龙江主流文旅 IP 梳理及现存问题对照 需要说明这一方法的两点限度：其一，工具检索的覆盖范围取决于公开信息，未被报道的民间设计难以纳入；其二，工具对“IP”的界定偏宽，会把活动标识、区域品牌一并计入，故复核阶段的取舍标准定为“是否具备持续运营的形象主体”。方法上的这种“先扩后收”，正是人机协同在资料阶段的典型形态：AI 负责覆盖，人负责定标。 2.3 选取赫哲族作为载体的依据 在可比选项中，赫哲族具备四项条件。第一，地域唯一性。赫哲族世居黑龙江、松花江与乌苏里江流域，是我国北方唯一以捕鱼为主要生计的少数民族，其文化形态与三江平原的江河环境直接绑定，无法被其他省份复制。第二，非遗密度。赫哲族拥有伊玛堪、鱼皮制作技艺、乌日贡大会、嫁令阔民歌等多项国家级非遗，其中“赫哲族鱼皮制作技艺”为第一批国家级非遗（编号Ⅷ-85），项目保护单位为黑龙江省民族博物馆[9]；伊玛堪于 2011 年列入联合国教科文组织急需保护的非物质文化遗产名录[10]，其语言与仪式价值在东北亚具有唯一性。第三，视觉可塑性。鱼皮肌理、渔猎图腾、江水纹样、民族服饰色彩构成了可直接转译的图形资源，且纹饰本身具有稳定的构成法则[7,8]。第四，品牌补位性。省内尚无以族群文化为核心的省级 IP，赫哲族恰好填补这一空位，与冰雪系列形成季节互补。上述判断的层次关系见图 2、图 3。 ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 4 图 2 赫哲族文旅 IP 核心打造重点与差异化优势 图 3 赫哲族 IP 作为黑龙江文旅差异化竞争载体的总结 3 分析框架：双轨协同的四个界面 3.1 分工原则：人工守核，AI 拓维 双轨协同不是把设计整体交给 AI，也不是让 AI 只做素材搬运，而是按“可判定性”划分职责。凡涉及文化归属、意义阐释、伦理边界的判断，由人承担；凡属选项扩展、方案穷举、形式变体的工作，交由 AI 承担。前者不可外包，因为其依据是文献、田野与族群内部的知识；后者可以外包，因为其成本主要是算力与时间。 3.2 四个协同界面 按设计流程拆解，人与 AI 在四个界面上交接。第一是符号萃取：AI 用于聚类与联想，人负责判定某一图形是否真的属于该族群、是否带有宗教或仪式含义。第二是提示词构建：AI 把自然语言意图转写为绘画命令，人负责校正文化细节，避免把“鱼皮”误作“皮革”。第三是初稿生成：AI 批量产出候选，人按文化准确度、形象亲和度与延展性筛选。第四是方案评估：AI 可给出风格、色彩、构图的对比，人则判断其是否越界。四个界面的关系，构成了本文所称的双轨机制。3.3 风险清单 协同过程至少存在三类风险。其一是文化失真：生成模型对少数民族服饰的训练样本有限，常以“民族风”泛化替代具体形制。其二是风格同质化：同一提示词在不同用户手中收敛到相近结果，ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 5 反而加剧视觉趋同，这与设计求异的初衷相悖[4]。其三是署名与版权：AI 产出与人工修改的贡献比例难以量化，公开使用时须说明工具与流程。三类风险都无法靠技术自身解决，只能靠制度约束。4 设计实践：从文化符号到 IP 原型 4.1 核心文化基底与视觉元素萃取 IP 的文化基底定为“渔猎文明＋鱼皮技艺＋伊玛堪说唱＋乌日贡民俗”四支。视觉层则从实物与文献中提取五类元素：鱼皮拼接形成的层状肌理、鱼皮纹饰中的云卷纹与螺旋纹、江河的水波纹、鱼与鸟的图腾形象、以及以紫、蓝、黑、白为主的服饰色彩[7,8]。萃取的原则是“取形不取义”：图形可以抽象化、系列化，但涉及仪式专用的纹样不入商品形象。 4.2 提示词构建与初稿生成 在确定文化底色之后，先用语言模型把设计意图转写为绘画命令。首轮提示词设定为“头戴赫哲族鱼皮帽、身穿鱼皮衣的赫哲族少女，健康的小麦肤色，神情自豪，坐在一条神圣的大马哈鱼上”。随后针对画风追加约束，如“动漫／半写实风，大马哈鱼带神话色彩”。提示词越具体，转写出的命令越接近预期，这一过程实质是把设计经验翻译为模型可读的参数。首轮命令与释义见图4，人物姿态的细化建议见图 5，鱼形神话化的要点见图 6。 图 4 IP 角色形象的英文提示词及中文释义 ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 6 图 5 人物姿势细化建议 图 6 大马哈鱼神话化设计要点 4.3 形象定稿、三视图与三维原型 在语言模型给出的要点基础上，把视觉描述进一步收束为“平视视角、水彩与动漫融合、黝黑带光泽的微卷渐变白发、天蓝空灵大眼、白色粉图腾鱼皮衣、挽弓姿态、蓝身红金尾的神鱼、祥云托底”，据此生成最终形象，见图 7。为保障后续建模的可实施性，再以“保持原有形象不变，生成三视图”为指令得到正、侧、背三视图，见图 8。原型阶段转用三维生成工具，以图生三维的方式直接输出模型，见图 9，使二维形象具备可旋转、可复用的资产属性。 ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 7 图 7 赫哲族少女 IP 最终形象方案 图 8 IP 形象三视图 ChinaXiv:202611.00143v1 This version posted 2026-11-16. 8 图 9 基于 IP 形象生成的三维模型 4.4 过程评估 从过程看，双轨机制的效果集中在三处：符号萃取阶段，AI 把文献检索与图形联想的时间压缩到小时级；初稿阶段，候选方案的产出量从“一周三稿”提高到“一小时十余稿”，使风格比较成为可能；三维阶段，图生模型免去了从二维到三维的重建环节。而在文化准确度上，AI 的贡献有限：鱼皮衣的镶边宽度、云卷纹的走向、色彩搭配的分寸，仍需依据馆藏实物与文献逐一校正[8,7]。这一“效率高、精度低”的分工格局，恰是双轨机制成立的前提。 5 讨论 5.1 原真性的守门机制 非遗类 IP 的原真性不在“像不像老物件”，而在“是否尊重其生成逻辑”。据此可设三道门：其一，形制门，服饰结构须与馆藏实物或文献记载相符，不得以想象的“民族风”替代；其二，语义门，凡使用图腾与仪式纹样，须能说明其原有含义，不能仅作装饰；其三，语境门，涉及祭祀与人生礼仪的符号不进入消费场景。三道门均由人把关，AI 只在门内提供选项。5.2 效率悖论与同质化风险 生成式工具的效率优势同时带来同质化压力。当同类提示词被广泛使用，产出的风格区间会迅速收窄，形成新的“AI 民族风”模板，这与设计求异的初衷相反[4,2]。破解之道不在拒绝工具，而在把“差异”写进流程：在提示词层引入地方性知识（具体鱼种、具体纹样、具体场合），在筛选层坚持人工淘汰，在评估层以“是否可被其他省份复制”作为反向指标。差异不是生成出来的，而是被筛选出来的。 的落地依赖省域层面的资源整合，包括可达性、人才与传播渠道，单靠形象设计无法完成[1]。 6 结论 本文以赫哲族非遗文旅 IP 为个案，提出并检验了“人工守核、AI 拓维”的双轨协同机制，将其拆解为符号萃取、提示词构建、初稿生成与方案评估四个界面，并通过从提示词到三视图、再到三维模型的完整流程加以验证。结论有三：其一，生成式人工智能的价值主要在选项扩展与效率提升，文化准确性的判断仍须由人承担；其二，双轨机制的有效性取决于界面划分是否清晰，界面模糊时效率优势会转化为同质化风险；其三，非遗类 IP 的原真性可通过形制、语义、语境三道门加以守持。研究的局限在于未开展受众认知与传播效果的量化验证，也未对不同生成工具作横向比较，后续工作将补足这两项，以使机制从个案经验走向可检验的方法。 参考文献 [1] 吴莹雨. 黑龙江冰雪旅游 IP 的创新设计[J]. 上海包装, 2026(6). 面部表现真实眉眼结构、自然眼距与微微上挑的冷艳眼神，保留皮肤纹理，妆容精致但不使用过度AI美颜。

下装：同色系极简三角底裤，腰侧与大腿根部连接细金链。

模特侧躺/斜倚在华丽雕花木椅上，身体微微向镜头扭转。
左臂自然伸展搭在椅背，右手轻放于椅面边缘。
上半身微微后仰，腰腹完全露出，双腿交叠或微微分开，强化腿部线条。
头部微侧，目光直视镜头，表情冷静带有轻微慵懒与诱惑。

50mm左右镜头，9:16半身偏全身构图，人物从头到大腿占据画面约85%。
仰角使锁骨、胸部轮廓与腰线更加清晰，同时保持真实透视，不使用极端鱼眼或过度夸张低机位。
薄纱与雕花椅背形成纵向框架，前景暖色光斑自然虚化。

主要光源为侧前方暖色柔光，形成：
皮肤与金饰的柔和高光。

人物身后轻微阴影。
前景有明显暖橙色圆形光斑（bokeh），背景高度虚化。
模拟夜间室内实拍质感，保留真实皮肤纹理与光影不完美，避免商业棚拍过度柔光。

**人体与服装结构要求**
双臂姿势自然，手指数量与形态正确。上衣镂空位置准确，金链垂坠合理。薄纱层次与褶皱真实。腰线、腿部与胸部比例符合真人透视。仰角下家具与人物比例一致，不出现畸形关节。
